applicability: Synchronized, same-polarity, far-field linear pair; supplied samples and unverified estimator error bound
numerical_path: Real numpy FFT, zero-padded PHAT over supported declared-band bins
sign: positive lag means channel 2 arrives later

peak_contract.score: absolute correlation; signed dominant peak must be positive
peak_contract.competitor: outside contiguous support and peak_exclusion_samples guard
peak_contract.qualification: single dominant score, bounded support width, inclusive minimum_peak_ratio
peak_contract.numerical_truth: Support/competitor ratio representation only; separate from timing/estimator model uncertainty, not measured confidence

delay_interval: full selected support plus timing_bound_samples and supplied estimator_error_bound_samples
geometry: extrema of tau*c/d over interval endpoints; no clipping or unique 3D angle claim
geometry_numerical_truth: Round dimensionless direction-cosine endpoints and worst-case alias ratio to 12 decimals before comparison; representation only, separate from physical bounds. Never clip a resolved exceedance to [-1,1].
assumptions: Model and error bounds are not measured or statistical confidence
Declared band must be alias-free at worst-case speed and spacing
excluded: Causal proof of direct versus reflected arrival
